dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Yes. You're dressed very ostentatiously indeed... So you're definitely not someone to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Think about it. Criminals would want to dress as discreetly as possible, no?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: That's based on my experience guarding this bridge, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: As long as this bridge is here, someone needs to guard it! We can't afford to let our guard down, not for one second.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: The bridge is a major thoroughfare. So to be handed the job of guarding it is the highest recognition I could ask for.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I will never let our enemies have their way, even if it costs me my life!
